zh: 奖励： 获得6荣誉. 拿取一张卡牌随机从 每位对手之梦境, 和将它们加入你的梦境.

en: REWARD: Gain 7H. Acquire the top three cards of the Dream deck without paying their cost.
zh: 奖励： 获得7荣誉. 获取顶部三 卡牌的 梦牌库无需支付其费用.

en:
Draw a card, then discard a card.
UNITE: Return a card from your discard pile to your hand.
zh:
抽一张牌，然后弃一张牌。
联合：从你的弃牌堆将一张牌收回手牌。

获得 1 符文。
联合：将你的符文加倍。

en: Gain 1R and 1P for each Mechana Construct you control.
zh: 获得1符文和 1战力以 每个机械神器你控制的.

获得 2 战力。
联合：将你的战力加倍。

en:
This Hero counts as all factions. Gain 3R, 3P, 3H.
If you control Pasythea's Ward, you may acquire this without paying its cost and put it into your hand.
zh:
此英雄视为所有派系. 获得3符文, 3战力, 3荣誉.
若你控制的帕西提亚的守护, 你可以获取此 无需支付费用，并将其放入你的手牌.

en: Once per turn, gain 1H for each faction among Constructs you control. (This card has no faction.)
zh: 每回合一次，获得1荣誉以 每个派系在你控制的神器之中. (此卡牌具有没有派系.)

en:
When you play a Mystic, gain 1R.
When you play a Heavy Infantry, gain 1P.
zh:
当你 打出秘教士, 获得1符文.
当你 打出重装步兵, 获得1战力.

en: Once per turn, when you acquire a card from your Dreamscape, you may add a card to your Dreamscape.
zh: 每回合一次，当你获取卡牌从 你的梦境, 你可以将一张卡牌加入你的梦境.

en: When you would gain H without defeating a Monster, gain twice that much H instead.
zh: 当你 会获得H没有击败怪物, 获得两次该 等量的H改为.

en: You may pay 1R less to acquire Constructs in the center row.
zh: 你可以支付 1符文少支付以 获取神器在中央牌列.

en: When you defeat a Monster in the center row, gain 2H.
zh: 当你在中央牌列击败怪物时, 获得2荣誉.

en: Banish all cards in the center row.
zh: 放逐所有卡牌在中央牌列.

en: Destroy all Constructs your opponents control.
zh: 摧毁所有神器你的对手控制.

en: Each player discards their hand and draws five cards.
zh: 每位玩家弃掉其 手牌和 抽五 卡牌.

en: Defeat a Monster in the center row without paying its cost.
zh: 在中央牌列击败一个怪物无需支付费用.

en: Reveal the top card of the center deck. Acquire or defeat it without paying its cost. If you acquire a Hero this way, put it into your hand.
zh: 展示传送门牌库顶的卡牌. 获取或 击败它 无需支付费用. 若你 获取一个英雄以此方式, 将其放入你的手牌.

en:
If you have played two Enlightened Heroes with the same name this turn, you may acquire this without paying its cost.
ONGOING: Once per turn, you may copy the effect of a Hero you have played this turn.
zh:
若你打出过两 圣贤英雄以 同名本回合, 你可以获取此 无需支付费用.
持续: 每回合一次，你可以复制效果的 英雄你 已打出本回合.

en: This turn you may spend R as though it was P.
zh: 此回合你可以花费R视为P.

en: Acquire a Hero in the center row without paying its cost.
zh: 获取中央牌列的一张英雄无需支付费用.

en:
If you have played three or more Lifebound Heroes this turn, you may acquire this without paying its cost.
Gain 10H.
ONGOING: You are considered to have played a Lifebound Hero each turn.
zh:
若你打出过三 或更高命约英雄本回合, 你可以获取此 无需支付费用.
获得10荣誉.
持续: 你为 视为以 已打出命约英雄每回合.

en: Acquire all Constructs in the center row without paying their cost.
zh: 获取所有神器在中央牌列无需支付其费用.

en:
If you control four or more Constructs, you may acquire this without paying its cost.
ONGOING: Your Mechana Heroes are Constructs instead. You may use their abilities once per turn.
zh:
若你控制四件或更多神器，你可以无需支付费用获取此牌。
持续：你的机械英雄改为神器。你每回合可使用它们的异能一次。

en: This turn you may defeat Monsters in the void as though they were in the center row.
zh: 此回合你可以击败怪物在 虚空区视为在中央牌列.

en: Banish up to 5 cards in your hand or discard pile.
zh: 放逐至多 5 卡牌在你的手牌或弃牌堆.

en:
If you have defeated three or more Monsters in the center row this turn, you may acquire this without paying its cost.
Gain 10H.
ONGOING: Once per turn, when you defeat a Monster, double its H reward.
zh:
若你本回合已在中央牌列击败三只或更多怪物，你可以无需支付费用获取此牌。
获得 10 荣誉。
持续：每回合一次，当你击败怪物时，将其荣誉奖励加倍。
